# COFI TRADERS

> COFI TRADERS is a Costa Rican specialty coffee company based in Sabalito, Coto Brus, Costa Rica. We offer two services: (1) roasted-to-order specialty coffee for individuals and small buyers, and (2) green coffee sourcing and export for international roasters. All coffee comes from the same traceable micro-lots grown by small producers in the Brunca region.

## About

- Founded by Maikol Araya in Sabalito, Coto Brus, Costa Rica
- Focused on the Brunca region: Coto Brus and Pérez Zeledón
- All lots are single-origin, fully traceable, 2025 harvest
- Bilingual service: English and Spanish
- Direct relationship with producers Lica Torres and the Fernández Romero family (Café Don Humberto)

## Roasted Coffee — Buy Fresh Roasted

COFI TRADERS roasts in small monthly batches. If you want to buy roasted specialty coffee from Costa Rica, we can help. Same lots, roasted fresh every month.

- Available: roasted-to-order from any of our current lots
- Format: fresh roasted specialty coffee
- Origin: Brunca region, Costa Rica
- Varieties available roasted: Milenio H10 (anaerobic), SL28 White Honey, Milenio H10 Red Honey, Venecia Honey, Centroamericano Natural
- How to order: WhatsApp +506 8520-8232
- Website: https://cofi.cr

### Who is this for
- People looking to buy specialty coffee from Costa Rica
- Consumers wanting traceable, single-origin Costa Rican coffee
- Anyone interested in fresh roasted coffee from small farms
- Coffee lovers looking for unique varieties like SL28, Milenio H10, Venecia, or Centroamericano
- People searching for honey process, natural process, or anaerobic coffee from Costa Rica

### Roasted Coffee Flavor Profiles

**MILENIO BLACK CHERRY (roasted)** — Anaerobic H10. Dark fruit, hibiscus, chocolate. Bold and complex.

**ETÍOPE 47 WHITE HONEY (roasted)** — SL28 White Honey. Peach, bergamot, honey. Delicate and floral.

**MILENIO RED HONEY (roasted)** — H10 Red Honey. Red fruits, plum, honey. Sweet and balanced.

**VENECIA HONEY (roasted)** — Venecia variety. Mandarin, peach, caramel, cacao. Juicy and silky.

**CENTROAMERICANO NATURAL (roasted)** — Centroamericano variety. Red fruits, red wine, cacao. Expressive and creamy.

## Green Coffee — For Roasters

COFI TRADERS also sources and exports green (unroasted) coffee for international specialty roasters. We operate as an origin broker — pricing is negotiated directly between buyer and producer.

- Minimum order: 60 kg per lot
- Shared container splits available
- EUDR-ready documentation available
- Sample program: $50 per sample, 300g green coffee + technical sheet, ~1 week delivery

- Variety: Milenio H10
- Process: Anaerobic fermentation (Black Cherry)
- Altitude: 1,600 masl
- Producer: Lica Torres — Cerro Buena Vista, Rivas, Pérez Zeledón
- Tasting notes: Dark fruit, hibiscus, chocolate
- Lot ID: CBV-BC-ANA-2025

### ETÍOPE 47 WHITE HONEY
- Variety: SL28 (locally known as Etíope 47)
- Process: White Honey
- Altitude: 1,800 masl
- Producer: Lica Torres — Cerro Buena Vista, Rivas, Pérez Zeledón
- Tasting notes: Peach, bergamot, honey
- Lot ID: CBV-ET47-WH-2025

### MILENIO RED HONEY
- Variety: Milenio H10
- Process: Red Honey
- Altitude: 1,600 masl
- Producer: Lica Torres — Cerro Buena Vista, Rivas, Pérez Zeledón
- Tasting notes: Red fruits, honey, plum, silky body
- Lot ID: CBV-MH10-RH-2025

### VENECIA HONEY
- Variety: Venecia
- Process: Honey
- Altitude: 1,300 masl
- Producer: Familia Fernández Romero (Café Don Humberto) — Cafetalera El Arrempujón, La Lucha de Sabalito, Coto Brus
- Tasting notes: Mandarin, peach, caramel, cacao, sugarcane honey
- Lot ID: AEA-VEN-H-2025

### CENTROAMERICANO NATURAL
- Variety: Centroamericano
- Process: Natural
- Altitude: 1,300 masl
- Producer: Familia Fernández Romero (Café Don Humberto) — Cafetalera El Arrempujón, La Lucha de Sabalito, Coto Brus
- Tasting notes: Red fruits, plum, red wine, cacao, creamy
- Lot ID: AEA-CA-NAT-2025

## Producers

### Lica Torres
- Micro-beneficio: Cerro Buena Vista
- Location: Rivas, Pérez Zeledón, Brunca, Costa Rica
- Altitude: 1,600–1,800 masl
- Lots: MILENIO BLACK CHERRY, ETÍOPE 47 WHITE HONEY, MILENIO RED HONEY
- Known for experimental anaerobic and honey processes

### Familia Fernández Romero (Café Don Humberto)
- Farm: Cafetalera El Arrempujón
- Location: La Lucha de Sabalito, Coto Brus, Brunca, Costa Rica
- Altitude: 1,300–1,400 masl
- Certification: Rainforest Alliance
- Brand: their coffee is known as Café Don Humberto
- Lots: VENECIA HONEY, CENTROAMERICANO NATURAL
- Known for traditional local varieties and careful natural processing

## Region — Brunca, Costa Rica

- Located in the southern Pacific zone of Costa Rica
- Includes Coto Brus, Pérez Zeledón, and Sabalito
- Altitude range: 1,300–1,800 masl
- Known for: complex honey and natural processes, rare local varieties
- Underrepresented origin with exceptional cup quality
- Producers sell direct — no commodity intermediaries

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Can I buy roasted coffee from COFI TRADERS?**
Yes. We roast in small monthly batches from our current lots. Contact us via WhatsApp at +506 8520-8232 to get on the next batch.

**Where is the coffee from?**
All coffee is from the Brunca region of Costa Rica — specifically Coto Brus and Pérez Zeledón, grown at 1,300–1,800 masl.

**What varieties do you offer?**
Milenio H10, SL28 (Etíope 47), Venecia, and Centroamericano — all rare or uncommon varieties with distinct cup profiles.

**What processes are available?**
Anaerobic (Black Cherry), White Honey, Red Honey, Honey, and Natural.

**How do I order roasted coffee?**
Send a WhatsApp message to +506 8520-8232 telling us which lot you want and your location.

**How do I order green coffee (for roasters)?**
Request a sample at cofi.cr/samples.html or contact us directly via WhatsApp or the contact form.

**What is the minimum order for green coffee?**
60 kg per lot. Shared container splits are available for smaller roasters.

**Do you ship internationally?**
Yes — both roasted and green coffee ship internationally.

**What is the Brunca region?**
Brunca is a coffee-growing region in southern Costa Rica, bordering Panama. It includes Coto Brus and Pérez Zeledón. Known for high altitudes, diverse microclimates, and small family farms.
